name: Derat — estados Azgaar candidatos dentro de Alfaguara

metadata.clip_boundary: Alfaguara polygon from the proposed global geography layer
metadata.selection_rule: Solo se incluyen estados Azgaar que contienen una etiqueta burg situada dentro del polígono propuesto de Alfaguara; se omiten polígonos con intersección marginal o sin burg visible en la región.
hard_limits: These are automatically generated Azgaar state polygons and names, not canonical political entities.
Geometry is clipped to the proposed continent outline for visual review; the clipping line is not a political border.
Do not assign these polygons to Bowit, Águila Roja, the Régimen or any city-state without author confirmation.
La ausencia de una etiqueta burg no demuestra ausencia de asentamientos; esta es una selección de revisión visual, no un inventario exhaustivo.

topology_audit.source_geometry: SVG-derived states.geojson; source path parts unioned by native Azgaar state ID, then clipped to proposed Alfaguara outline.
topology_audit.simplification: Shapely coverage_simplify tolerance 0.12 degrees; shared boundaries preserved.

checks.shared_boundaries: line-only contacts between adjacent selected candidates
checks.burg_point_in_its_labeled_state: previously verified for all four points

limits: The native .map file verifies state IDs, names, burg positions and generated population, but the rebuilt polygon geometry is sourced from SVG-derived state paths, not native cell polygons.
Only four states selected by the burg-in-Alfaguara rule are included; gaps between them are intentional omissions, not unclaimed or uninhabited territory.
Azgaar names and polygons remain generated cartographic candidates, not canon, city-states, sovereignty or faction control.
The proposed Alfaguara clipping outline is not a political border.

metadata.native_map_name_correction: The native .map state record identifies state6 as Neutiersia; the SVG-derived label Neutiersian League was incorrect.
metadata.geometry_action: Rebuilt four candidate state geometries from source SVG-derived state paths, unioned by native state ID and clipped to proposed Alfaguara; shared-boundary-preserving coverage simplification removed the four crossing segments without changing their noncanonical status.
